name: L18.name
idea: Ghosts and possessed things betray you

trolls.name: A ghost creeps up behind you
A chair hops after you and squashes you
The planks vanish when you look back
The mirror shows the real floor
A wrong piano key drops you
A mirror ghost meets you in the doorway
The ghost drops its plank when you look at it
The planks only exist in the lamp light
The furniture only moves when you look away
The ghost platform vanishes behind you
The stairs only appear when you look back
The doors slam on anyone who runs
The flying carpet sinks when you walk on it
The lift rises while your back is turned
The EXIT is only real from behind
